Definition: Age in years at which an individual becomes eligible to register for digital ID
Comments: Eritreans 18 years and older are required to obtain a national ID card. Children under 18 born to Eritrean parents can obtain an Underage ID. Eritreans aged 18-35 without a national ID can apply for a temporary ID. This tiered system covers eligibility from childhood through adulthood.
